svg.aria-label: Animated 5×4 grid of MNIST predictions, with green ticks for correct predictions and red crosses for misclassifications
svg.title: MNIST Champion — Animated Test Grid
svg.desc: Each cell cross-fades through several test digits over a 9-second loop. Pixel intensity is mapped to a purple-to-yellow ramp; the label below shows true/predicted classes — green when the network is correct, red when it is wrong.
svg.text: Validation accuracy: 9.51% · Test accuracy: 9.31% · Green ✓ = correct prediction, red ✗ = wrong
Animated cells cycle every 9s — each cell shows several held-out test digits classified by the champion network.
